description: Get the point-in-time float history for a company: one sample per trade date (float shares, shares outstanding, and the source the float came from), showing the float on a past date and how it expanded across a dilution event. The series is forward-only: it began accumulating in mid-2026 and is not backfilled, so early or absent history is expected and an empty rows array is a normal result, not an error or a sign of delisting. Each row carries "source" ("computed", "sec_10k" or a market-data vendor tier) because float quality varies by provider.

days.description: Lookback window in trade dates. Default 90, clamped to 1-730.

name: get_float_history
title: Get Float History
